clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most people copy success backwards.

They watch a millionaire today - relaxed, unhurried, fully in control - and copy that version of them. Wrong move. That's not how the money got made.

Copy how they acted when they were broke and just starting out instead: the 14, 15, 16-hour days, seven days a week, for years, before any of it got easy.

A plane needs full throttle just to leave the runway. Once it's cruising, the throttle pulls back. Confuse the two and you'll spend your life copying the cruise, wondering why you never take off.

Are you copying someone's grind, or just their lifestyle?

#kevintrudeau #successhabits #wealthmindset #hustle #moneymindset #richmindset

Aristotle Onassis became one of the richest men who ever lived.

Kevin Trudeau says that before the fortune, back when Onassis was flat broke, he still spent what little money he had to eat at the restaurants where wealthy people ate.

Not to pitch anyone. Not to network. Just to be in the room with them.

Trudeau calls it one of the oldest money secrets there is: get physically close to winners and some of it rubs off on you. Success breeds success.

Who are the five people you spend the most time with, and what are they making of their lives?
